_comment: Document vocabulary of the stage-10 document package (10_06, 10_07, 10_08). The report documents themselves live in paths.data.report_output_dir, the direction-F workspace outside this repository. Their titles are the exact file-name stems of the Markdown sources and of the PDFs built from them, and they are not ASCII; docs/coding_standard.md keeps every file of the repository ASCII, so each title is written here as a JSON \uXXXX escape and json.load decodes it back to the exact name on disk. Declared order is the build order.
